record_id.title: Record Id
record_id.description: Stable ID (BOOK_CODE). Auto-assigned on create if omitted.

RecordIn.title: RecordIn
RecordIn.description: Admin/API input for create / replace. Only record_id (optional on create) and title are required.

RecordPatch.title: RecordPatch
RecordPatch.description: Partial update: only provided fields change. record_id is immutable.

q.title: Q
q.description: Query (Arabic or English). Empty + filters = browse.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: title/supervisor/student/subject = structured & EXHAUSTIVE; keyword/semantic/hybrid = ranked (NOT exhaustive); auto/all = tiered

fuzzy.title: Fuzzy
fuzzy.description: title mode: also return approximate matches (labelled)

SearchRequest.title: SearchRequest
SearchRequest.description: JSON body of POST /search. Same semantics (and the same engine) as GET /search; `q` may be empty when filters are given.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.description: Which retrieval strategies produced the results, in priority order.

exhaustive.title: Exhaustive
exhaustive.description: True when `total` is the COMPLETE set of matching records (structured search). False when ranked retrieval was cut off at a candidate pool.

student_resolution.description: Same shape as supervisor_resolution; `matched` lists students (key, name, record_count). Names are never merged.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Original spellings that normalise to this key (only present when more than one). They are matched together for search; the originals are preserved on every record.

similar_not_merged.title: Similar Not Merged
similar_not_merged.description: Distinct names with similar spelling. NOT merged automatically (may be a different person).

embedding.title: Embedding
embedding.description: indexed | pending (record is saved and searchable by keyword; embedding retried)
